meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你设置或检查记忆的云同步：检查同步状态、写入从 cmem.ai 获取的连接信息、重启验证，并且全程不泄露同步令牌。
howto.when: 当你说 set up cloud sync、sync my memories 等，或要求把记忆备份/同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.note: Claude 会向你询问连接信息
Claude 会查询并报告状态

say.text: 我的记忆备份到 cmem.ai 了吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查配置并回答

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you set up or check memory cloud sync: check sync status, write connection info from cmem.ai, restart and verify, without ever exposing the sync token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", etc., or ask to back up/sync memories to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Help me set up cloud sync
say_en.note: Claude will ask for connection details
Claude will query and report status

say_en.text: Is my memory backed up to cmem.ai?
say_en.note: Claude will check configuration and answer
